learn.h: Why can't we just add the bottoms?
learn.text: (1)/(2) + (1)/(3) One halfOne third The bottom number tells you the size of the pieces. Halves and thirds are different sizes, so we can't add them yet.And 2/5 is wrong: it's less than one half!

learn.h: Cut them into same size pieces
learn.text: 1/2 = 3/61/3 = 2/6 Find the smallest number both bottoms go into. 2 and 3 both go into 6. That's the least common denominator. To turn halves into sixths we multiply the bottom by 3, so we multiply the top by 3 too.

(3)/(6) + (2)/(6) = (5)/(6) Same size pieces: 3 sixths + 2 sixths = 5 sixths. The bottom stays 6. Every problem goes in 5 steps: find the LCD, rewrite the first, rewrite the second, add, simplify. Your finished steps stay on the page like written work.
